title: Perfect guided tour - professionally organized
text:
The tour with our guide Cristian was an exceptional and unique experience. Simply excellent - I can really recommend this deal - and we were absolutely happy with Cristian as our guide: competent, professional and super sympathetic. 
The whole tour was perfectly organized and made the visit to Granada unforgettable.
Thank you so much !!
author: johannesjosefmak

title: Excellent and very complete Alhambra tour
text: This was excellent, very detailed and interesting information and easy entry to the Nasrid palaces (Wow - don't miss it), Generalife gardens, and Alcazaba.   Our guide Christian was very clear and organized and packed a lot of info into our 3+ hour tour.  (Our tour was delayed from 11am to 3pm, which fortunately was not a problem for us and we were told the day before - but perhaps good to have a flexible schedule.)
author: kimtN6537BO

title: An incredible visit
text:
A very complete visit.
We went with the children and they never got bored. We avoided the long individual lines, since we entered with our guide through special access and he was attentive to all our needs.
I recommend it 100 x100.
